review_unsupported_claims: The cited §4.2 sentence is about the validation group's ability to assess performance independently, not about checking vendor test results against risk appetite. Since no vendor results are received (§4.1), nothing exists to check, so 'contradicts' is a stretch.
review_comment: The document never mentions risk appetite, and §4.1 shows no vendor test results are received, so this limb is unmet rather than contradicted. The cited §4.2 „არ აქვს შესაძლებლობა, დამოუკიდებლად შეაფასოს“ concerns independent validation, not the appetite check. The proposal merely restates the gap in the report and adds the invented duty to check; it does not fix anything.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence line claims the bank 'has no resource' to verify the model; §4.2 says it has no access to scores and the validation group cannot independently assess, which is close but not literally about resources.
review_comment: §4.1 shows the vendor does not report, and §4.2 „ვალიდაციის ჯგუფს არ აქვს შესაძლებლობა, დამოუკიდებლად შეაფასოს მოდელის შესრულება“ shows the bank cannot self-verify, which conflicts with 'უნდა გააჩნდეს რესურსი თავად შეამოწმოს'. The proposal rewrites the finding as a statement of fact with a vague 'self-monitoring resources' phrase and copies the operational figures without fixing anything.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation drops the second duty in the regulation ('დაასაბუთოს ახალი საზედამხედველო მოდელის უპირატესობა').
review_comment: The duty applies when a new supervisory model replacing an old one is presented to the National Bank. A quarterly monitoring report neither presents such models nor has any replacement in play, so a 'none' gap is not meaningful. The proposed new section 2.2 would also be misplaced in the report.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation omits the documentation duty and the data-suitability/methodology-fit sentence of the regulation. The proposal heading is placed at 3.2.3, a section about a post-migration data incident.
review_comment: The duty falls on first-line model building: „მოდელის აგების ეტაპზე უნდა შეფასდეს“. The system itself notes the document is a monitoring report, which is not where build-stage data assessment is documented, so reporting a gap is not valid. The proposal merely restates the regulation as report text.

The duty concerns data-quality methodology, normally set in internal policy-procedures (compare art5/p6), not a quarterly monitoring report. Treating its absence as a gap is wrong, and proposing a 'new_document' for a report is not a fix to the report.

„მოდელთან დაკავშირებული დოკუმენტაცია“ is one factor in the model-ranking methodology that the entity must build for risk-based validation planning, a policy-level matter. A monitoring report has no obligation to list it, so 'none' is not a real gap.

„მოდელების ურთიერთდამოკიდებულება“ is a component of the risk-ranking methodology for validation planning, not content a periodic monitoring report must carry. Its absence is not a compliance gap in this document.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation says 'კომერციული ბანკისა და მიკრობანკის' for a document that belongs to a commercial bank; fine, but the duty is the Supervisory Board's own assurance, not something a report must describe. This version of the provision also dates from 2023-07-01, after the report period (Q1 2022).
review_comment: „სამეთვალყურეო საბჭოს წევრები უნდა დარწმუნდნენ“ is a governance duty of the board, not a content requirement for a monitoring report. The report's distribution to the CRO, committee and directorate in §7.1 is not meant to evidence it, and the 2023 effective date postdates the report. Treating this as a gap is not valid.
